SRM-20 run plan: golden_rml  [Roland SRM-20]
Send each file via VPanel: Cut -> Add -> Output. Zero Z on the copper first, with VPanel on G54; X and Y stay at the machine origin.
VPanel lists the files alphabetically: move the cutout to the bottom.
Order: 0) airpass  1) drill  2) traces  3) cutout. Re-set Z-zero after each bit change; keep XY origin.
0. airpass — golden_rml_airpass.rml: DRY RUN, spindle stays off and the bit is held 5 mm up. Watch it trace where the board will be cut. If it leaves the copper, stop and re-place the stock — nothing has been cut yet. Run this before every job.
1. drill  — golden_rml_drill.rml: one 0.8 mm bit, plunge holes that fit + interpolate larger ones, total 1.7 mm
2. traces  — bit 0.8 mm, 1 offsets, cut 0.15 mm/pass, feed 4.0 mm/s
3. cutout  — bit 0.8 mm, 4 tabs x 1.5 mm, total 1.7 mm
Board mirrored for bottom-up milling: True.
Estimated run time (excludes tool changes, spin-up and pauses):
   golden_rml_airpass.rml: ~38s
   golden_rml_drill.rml: ~2m 41s
   golden_rml_traces.rml: ~14m 49s
   golden_rml_cutout.rml: ~5m 33s
   TOTAL: ~23m 40s
